page: Vultr vbm-48c-1024gb-4-a100-gpu is a bare metal server configuration within the Bare Metal SSD family. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 6342 processor with 48 physical cores and 96 vCPUs operating at a base frequency of 2.8 GHz. The system is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 10.67 GB of RAM per core.

This server is configured with four NVIDIA Ampere A100 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 320 GB of VRAM. Local storage consists of a 900 GB SSD. The inclusion of dedicated bare metal hardware ensures that resources are not shared with other tenants, eliminating virtualization overhead and noisy-neighbor performance degradation.

Given the high-density GPU and memory allocation, this server represents a high-resource hardware class designed for intensive parallel processing tasks. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for enterprise-scale workloads that require massive memory bandwidth and GPU acceleration, avoiding the overhead of multi-node clustering. The hardware profile is suited for large language model training, deep learning, complex data science jobs, high-performance computing, and large-scale database operations.
